constraints: Returns Null if no header is found for the given parameter(s).

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Returns the header of the first page in the range or the section/sub-section passed as targetObj (returns the visible header if a sub-section is active).
Returns the header of the section identified by sectionIndex (>=1) in wpDoc, or of a specific sub-section type of that section when subSectionType is passed.
